I've answered Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from #north-team, a channel she's in. On 20 Aug 2025 she first posted 180 seats, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

I couldn't find the amendment itself in any file I can access. So I told her that if the QBR deck needs the number checked against the signed copy, June Osei-Lark has it.

A seat count counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
